map.参考基价 2 万/㎡、楼层系数 1.0、朝向南 1.05、装修 1.1、学区 1: Base price 20,000 yuan/sqm, floor factor 1.0, south facing 1.05, fit-out 1.1, catchment 1.1, extra 0, age 10 years (factor = max(0.8, 1 − 10 × 0.005) = 0.95): appraised unit price = 20000 × 1 × 1.05 × 1.1 × 1.1 × 0.95 ≈ 24,140 yuan/sqm; a 100 sqm unit is worth about 2.414 million yuan.
map.评估总价 241.4 万，合理价格区间 ±5% 即 229.3 万–253.5: On an appraised total of 2.414 million yuan the reasonable range of ±5% is 2.293 to 2.535 million, so list within that band and negotiate up or down.
map.房龄系数为什么有下限 0.8？: Why is the age factor floored at 0.8?
map.避免房龄过大把价值压到过低，规范常设 0.8 下限，老房价值更多靠地段与改造潜力: To stop a very old building being valued too low; standards commonly set a floor of 0.8, since older stock draws value from location and conversion potential.
map.学区系数怎么取？: How is the catchment factor set?
map.按对口学校质量 0.95–1.15，单校划片变动风险大，系数应注明依据并可随政策: It follows the quality of the assigned school at 0.95-1.15; single-school catchment changes are risky, so state the basis and allow for policy shifts.
